comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet: Thanks for the report and the extra context. What happened here: when a task dialog opens (e.g. the disconnect confirmation when you close an active tab), mRemoteNG plays the matching system sound via `System.Media.SystemSounds`. That type lives in `System.Windows.Extensions.dll`, which is part of the **.NET Windows Desktop runtime** — it isn't inside the portable ZIP, it's resolved from the runtime installed on the machine.
